Kind 'recording' (the historic 78 rpm archive, approved 2026-09-26, .docs/assets/archive-78rpm.md) lists the exact original files with their sha256 and is cached in assets-src/audio/78rpm/<id>/; risk 'us-risky' entries are public domain in Turkey but not yet in the US and may reach builds only from private-assets/.
